For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Chakrvarti Singh Rathore
For Respondent(s) : Mr. M.S. Bhati, Pp
 Mr. Bhawani Singh, for respondent
 No.2
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Garg
Order 18/04/2023

The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing of the criminal proceedings in FIR No.263/2022 of Police Station Deedwana, District Nagaur for offence under Sections 498-A, 406, 323, 354 and 377 of IPC.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioner and complainant have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675 in which it has been held that the proceedings under Section 498A IPC can be quashed because it is the matrimonial matter, the criminal proceedings in [2023/RJJD/010493] (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-1787/2023] FIR No.263/2022 lodged at Police Station Deedwana, District Nagaur is liable to be set aside.
Accordingly, the criminal proceedings in FIR No.263/2022 lodged at Police Station Deedwana,
Daulat Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/010493) on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53394786/
1 District Nagaur is hereby set aside on the basis of the compromise arrived at between the parties.
The misc. petition is disposed of.
